`RustEventContractDepthFragment` embeds a depth fragment with the

doc:
V1 5-variant `NormalDepthViewModel` family selector.

V1 source (KB 10-depth.md section "5 business-line NormalDepthViewModel"):
each variant attaches a distinct observer set on `TradePageDataRepository`:

| Variant | Observers                                                |
|---------|----------------------------------------------------------|
| Spot    | markPriceItem + indexTickerItem (2)                      |
| Margin  | markPriceItem + indexTickerItem (2 — same as Spot)       |
| Swap    | mark + index + fundingRate + estimatePrice + offlinePlan |
| Future  | mark + index + estimatePrice (3)                         |
| Option  | tickerPriceItem + mark + index + estimatePrice + optSum  |

The variant also drives the V1 amount-precision rules
(KB 10-depth.md section "Amount precision rules"):
• Spot / Margin → 3 digits (or `max(2, minSize precision)` when <1000)
• Swap / Future UNIT_U → contract→USDT (linear 2 / inverse 3 digits)
• Swap / Future UNIT_COIN → contract→coin (linear 2 / inverse 3 digits)
• Option → 3 digits

The Kotlin Pure Fragment uses `update_variant(...)` to push the active
variant after `update_inst_type(...)`, then the renderer picks the right
column count + format helper per the table above.
